Completed the Context Conflict Check; no conflicts were found.

Start script now binds the server and tunnel to 127.0.0.1, shares one running-PID helper, and the Stop script's manual hint uses Stop-Process -Id; smoke-tested start/stop.

Added MR-only session, 4-state sky sphere, exit countdown panel, HOMES table, thumbstick repeat, build timestamp, translucent cube/board, and a B-button appearance panel (colour picker, brightness, opacity, shared shape border) with a 2D colour table; new default colours captured from the user's screenshot.
